from.description: Start of the range, as the last edit mapped it.

to.description:
End of the range, exclusive. Equal to `from` once an edit has deleted
the text the range covered: the comment then marks nothing.

version.description:
The body version the range was last read at, as the editor that
reported it numbers the collaborative field. Absent until an editor has
reported. A report of an earlier version is one that reached the
pattern late, and leaves the anchor where a later one put it.

authorProfile.description: The profile the reply was made under.

createdAt.description: The handler clock when the reply was made, in milliseconds.

authorProfile.description: The profile the comment was made under.

createdAt.description: The handler clock when the comment was made, in milliseconds.

id.description: Names the comment to the editor and the verbs; minted when it is made.

replies.description: Replies in the order made. A reply is not anchored, so this does not recurse.

resolved.description: Whether the comment is settled. A resolved comment marks no text.

comments.description: Comments on the body, shared by every viewer.

addComment.description:
Adds a comment under the caller's profile on the range `from..to` of the
body, and refuses a range that is not within the body with `from` before
`to`, a blank `body`, or a caller with no profile.

appendLine.description: Adds `text` to the end of the document, on a line of its own.

prependLine.description: Adds `text` to the start of the document, on a line of its own.

replaceText.description:
Replaces the one occurrence of `old` in the document with `new`, and
refuses when `old` is empty, occurs nowhere, or occurs more than once.

resolveComment.description: Marks the comment named by `id` resolved, and refuses an unknown `id`.
